description: The bar chart illustrates the "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks." The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," displaying nine benchmarks: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with labels rotated diagonally for readability. The vertical axis is the value axis, labeled "Score (%)," featuring a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The chart uses grouped vertical bars to represent two different models, as indicated by the legend titled "Model." Within each benchmark category, a blue bar represents "LLaMA-3-8B-it" on the left, and an orange bar represents "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" on the right; both sets of bars and the chart background feature a speckled visual texture. The highest scores for both models are observed in the GSM-8K category, where the blue bar reaches approximately 79% and the orange bar reaches approximately 80%. The lowest score for the LLaMA-3-8B-it model is in the Chat-Arena-Hard category at roughly 20%, while the lowest score for the Ours (Iterative RLHF) model is in the same category at approximately 29%. Other representative values include TruthfulQA, where the blue bar is near 44% and the orange bar is near 60%, and MBPP, where both models score approximately 61%. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted in a strict alphabetical or descending numerical order, and no specific bars are visually emphasized with outlines or annotations beyond the standard textured fill.
